component.name: salesforce
component.description: Sends Extole events to Salesforce CRM via authenticated webhook — keeps Contact and Lead records in sync when advocates earn rewards, share links, or refer friends.

values.default: Send Extole events to Salesforce CRM contacts and leads.

When Extole events fire (reward earned, share clicked, friend registered), this integration POSTs the event data to your Salesforce org's REST endpoint, updating the matching Contact or Lead record automatically.

settings.name: sfdcEndpointUrl
settings.description: Copy from the Extole 'Receive Events' tab in your Salesforce org. Format: https://your-org.my.salesforce.com/services/apexrest/extole/events

settings.name: clientKey
settings.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials (consumer key + consumer secret) from your Salesforce Connected App. Used to obtain bearer tokens for the REST API.

values.default: javascript@buildtime:(function(){ var items = Java.from(context.getComponent().createElementsQuery().withType('WEBHOOK').withTag('internal:app_type=extole-sfdc-app').list()); return items && items.length > 0 ? items[0].getId() : null; })()

webhooks.name: javascript@buildtime:context.getComponent().getName() + '_writeback'
webhooks.description: POSTs Extole event data to the Salesforce REST endpoint. Authenticated via OAuth 2.0 client credentials from the configured Connected App.
